limits: Tenfold/grand/rich/dramatic character requires listening; no signal statistic approves those qualities.
Frequency, RMS, first-difference, DC and sample-peak measurements are not LUFS, device true peak, timbre approval or headphone QA.
A zero sample seam and bounded 5 ms edge metrics do not certify a seamless perceived loop.
Raw mixtures use no voice cap and can exceed unity; separate fixed headroom results do not establish the actual runtime mix.
Processing originals are existing first-decode Float32 files. This QA performs no new native decode, browser run or provider call.

pairedAuditions.method: Independent PCM inspection of two ordered actual-file segments, applied gains, silent gap, RMS matching within 2e-5 and peak ceilings. RMS matching is not LUFS or human equal-loudness approval.
